title: adenophora liliifolia subvar. subverticillata
intro: Adenophora liliifolia subvar. subverticillata, commonly known as White Flowered Adenophora, is a plant species belonging to the Campanulaceae family. It is a perennial herb used in traditional medicine, particularly in East Asian countries such as China, Japan, and Korea. The plant is valued for its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which are thought to provide relief from various health issues. The bioactive constituents of White Flowered Adenophora include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are believed to exhibit therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, antiviral, and anti-cancer activities.
